groups.title: Power: Wind turbine (1x1)
groups.note: Rotor turns (4 frames); stopped when inactive.

groups.title: Power: Coal power plant (2x2)
groups.note: Chimney smoke 4 frames; no smoke when inactive.

groups.title: Power: Solar power plant (2x2)
groups.note: Panel rows tilt toward the light.

groups.title: Power: Gas power plant (3x3)
groups.note: Hot exhaust 4 frames.

groups.title: Power: Hydroelectric dam (3x3)
groups.note: Raised reservoir behind the wall, spillway foam animates. Implementation: needs a river; art includes its own water.

groups.title: Power: Nuclear power plant (3x3)
groups.note: Two cooling towers with steam (4 frames); reactor dome.

groups.title: Water: Water tower (1x1)
groups.note: Tank on legs; red aircraft-warning beacon lit at night.

groups.title: Water: Water pump (1x1)
groups.note: Pump house with an intake pipe running into a small intake pond.

groups.title: Water: Pumping station (2x2)
groups.note: Pump hall, two open settling basins, intake pipes and a chemical store.

groups.title: Police: Police box (1x1)
groups.note: Small blue kiosk with a blue lamp, white POLICE band.

groups.title: Police: Police station (2x2)
groups.note: Flag waves (4 frames). Garage and cell block are drawn inside the same 2x2.

groups.title: Police: Police headquarters (3x3)
groups.note: Tall glass tower over a podium, roof helipad (no helicopter: LIFE), car park.

groups.title: Police: Prison (3x3)
groups.note: Perimeter wall, four watchtowers, gatehouse, two cell blocks, exercise yard; third cell block as upgrade.

groups.title: Fire: Firehouse (1x1)
groups.note: One open red bay with the engine inside, hose tower, FIRE sign on the roof.

groups.title: Fire: Fire station (2x2)
groups.note: Three open red bays with engines, drill tower at the back; the engine bay upgrade adds a fourth.

groups.title: Fire: Fire helipad (2x2)
groups.note: Pad and hangar only: the helicopter is LIFE's.

groups.title: Fire: Fire watch tower (1x1)
groups.note: Timber lookout tower with a glazed cab among pines.

groups.title: Health: Medevac helipad (2x2)
groups.note: Pad only: the helicopter is LIFE's.

groups.title: Education: College (3x3)
groups.note: Campus blocks around a quad; the gate faces the viewer.

groups.title: Education: University (3x3)
groups.note: Domed great hall with portico, clock tower, lawns; the landmark of the education set.

groups.title: Parks & plazas: Small park (1x1)
groups.note: Curved footpaths, benches, flower beds, lamp.

groups.title: Parks & plazas: Plaza (1x1)
groups.note: Animated fountain (4 frames).

groups.title: Parks & plazas: Large park (2x2)
groups.note: Playground, pond with fountain and ducks, gazebo (4 frames).

groups.title: Parks & plazas: Sports field (2x2)
groups.note: Floodlights glow at night; stands along the back.

groups.title: Garbage: Landfill (3x3)
groups.note: Lined pit; the heap grows with the fill level 0..100%.

groups.title: Garbage: Incinerator (3x3)
groups.note: Stack smoke 4 frames: dark and heavy, whiter and thinner with the exhaust filter.

groups.title: Garbage: Recycling centre (3x3)
groups.note: Sorting hall with conveyors, colourful bales and containers.

groups.title: Deathcare: Cemetery (3x3)
groups.note: Gravestone rows fill with the fill level 0..100%.

groups.title: Deathcare: Crematorium (2x2)
groups.note: Slim chimney wisp (4 frames), hearse at the door.

groups.title: Communications & post: Post office (2x2)
groups.note: Yellow/red post vans; the van depot upgrade adds a garage with a second row of vans.

groups.title: Communications & post: Sorting centre (3x3)
groups.note: Big shed with loading docks and parcel trucks; purple signage.

groups.title: Communications & post: Telecom mast (1x1)
groups.note: Red/white lattice mast with dishes and antenna panels; red beacon lit at night.

groups.title: Communications & post: Telecom tower (2x2)
groups.note: Concrete broadcast tower with an observation pod and a lit spire.

groups.title: Administration: City hall (3x3)
groups.note: Classical hall: portico, pediment, gold dome, flag (4 frames), fountain forecourt.

groups.title: Administration: Welfare office (2x2)
groups.note: Civic office with a deep canopy, benches and a queue.

groups.title: Industry hubs: Farm hub (3x3)
groups.note: Barn, silos, farmhouse, tractor. Extractor field tiles are the areas/ set.

groups.title: Industry hubs: Forestry hub (2x2)
groups.note: Sawmill shed, log piles, log truck and loader, conifers.

groups.title: Industry hubs: Quarry hub (3x3)
groups.note: Crusher tower with inclined conveyor, gravel heaps, dump truck, stepped rock face at the back.

groups.title: Industry hubs: Mine hub (3x3)
groups.note: Headframe with turning winding wheel (4 frames), winding house, spoil heap, ore wagons on a track.

groups.title: Industry hubs: Oil hub (2x2)
groups.note: Storage tanks, small refinery column, gas flare flame (4 frames).

groups.title: Industry hubs: Fish hub (2x2)
groups.note: Half the footprint is water (right side): quay, pier with crates, fish hall with ice sign, nets drying. No boats here (LIFE owns them). Water ripples over 4 frames.

groups.title: Industry hubs: Oil derrick (pumpjack) (1x1)
groups.note: Placed by the oil hub inside its area. Walking beam rocks over 4 frames.

groups.title: Extractor areas: Grain field (1x1)
groups.note: Variant 0 / day = ripe wheat; stages: ploughed, sprouting, growing, stubble. Winter = fallow, snowy.

groups.title: Extractor areas: Vegetable field (1x1)
groups.note: Variant 0 / day = ready to harvest (cabbage, lettuce, red cabbage rows); ploughed, sprouting, growing. Winter = bare beds.

groups.title: Extractor areas: Cotton field (1x1)
groups.note: Variant 0 / day = open white bolls; ploughed, sprouting, growing (pink-white flowers). Winter = bare red soil.

groups.title: Extractor areas: Orchard (1x1)
groups.note: Variant 0 / day = fruiting trees (red apples); saplings, young, mature (no fruit). Winter = bare trees.

groups.title: Extractor areas: Livestock pasture (1x1)
groups.note: Variant 0 / day = cows with back fence and a trough; sheep, calves in a corner, open pasture. Fences only on the tile edges that border another pasture.

groups.title: Extractor areas: Forestry plantation (1x1)
groups.note: Variant 0 / day = mature conifers; saplings (planted rows), young, felled (stumps + log stack). Trees are never cut by the tile edge.

groups.title: Extractor areas: Quarry pit (1x1)
groups.note: Variant 0 / day = shallow bench; deeper pit tiles get higher terraces, darker rock, rubble and a puddle. Terraces run along x so neighbours join.

groups.title: Extractor areas: Mine spoil and track (1x1)
groups.note: Variant 0 / day = gravel with empty track; track + loaded tub, spoil heaps, ore pile with two tubs.

groups.title: Extractor areas: Oil pad (1x1)
groups.note: Variant 0 / day = gravel pad with two pipes; pipes and valve manifold, barrels, pump skid. Pipes run along x, supports repeat every 0.25 so tiles join.

groups.title: Extractor areas: Fishing water (1x1)
groups.note: Variant 0 / day = buoy line; floating net cage, net curtain, marker buoy. The sea animates (8-frame water shader). No boats here (LIFE).

groups.title: Transit: Bus depot (3x2)
groups.note: Garage hall at the back, forecourt with buses, fuel pumps and wash bay on the right.

groups.title: Transit: Taxi depot (2x2)
groups.note: Dispatch office with a roof sign, workshop, yellow taxis in marked bays.

groups.title: Transit: Metro station (1x2)
groups.note: Entrance pavilion with a stairwell down to the platforms and the big M roundel on a pole.

groups.title: Transit: Tram depot (3x2)
groups.note: Brick hall; three tracks run out of its doors across a gravel yard. Parked trams are simple boxes.

groups.title: Transit: Train station (2x4)
groups.note: Terminus: station hall with a clock tower at the front, island platform with a long canopy, a track each side. Trains are LIFE's.

groups.title: Transit: Rail yard (3x2)
groups.note: Four sidings with parked wagons, buffer stops, signals and a signal box.

groups.title: Transit: Cargo harbor (3x3)
groups.note: Quay on the right with an empty ship berth (ship is LIFE's); two gantry cranes whose trolleys move over 4 frames, container stacks, straddle carrier.

groups.title: Transit: Cargo airport (3x3)
groups.note: Runway segment with edge lights, arched hangar, control tower and cargo apron. Aircraft are LIFE's.

groups.title: Outside connections: Highway entry (highway-w / -e / -n / -s) (1x1)
groups.note: One model for the 4 actors highway-w/e/n/s: they use the 4 facings (the road runs along the facing's y axis, the sign faces the incoming traffic).

groups.title: Shared: rubble (1x1, one per footprint cell)
Animation and facing strips (engine-ready, anchor-aligned frames)
